title: Egyptian Squid Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired stew from Egypt, featuring tender squid and a rich tagine sauce. This dish is a true representation of the region's culinary prowess.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the squid, tagine spice mix, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the squid starts to change color.
Add the wine (if using) and cook until the liquid has almost completely evaporated, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes, or until the squid is tender.
Stir in some chopped parsley and serve over rice or couscous.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
Serve hot, enjoying the rich flavors of this North African-inspired stew.
